title: LTM: Latent Transition Based In-Context Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $\pi_{0.5}$ as LTM-$\pi$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$\pi$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. translated_title: LTM：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的基于潜在转移的上下文记忆
translated_abstract: 机器人操作常常需要记住那些已经不可见的交互。我们提出了潜在转移记忆，它将历史信息存储为相邻观测之间的紧凑潜在转移。该方法在 $\pi_{0.5}$ 上实例化为 LTM-$\pi$，利用冻结的潜在动作编码器、轻量级适配器和因果 KV 缓存实现增量推理，无需记忆专用的语义标注或外部推理模型调用。借助 DreamDojo 转移，LTM-$\pi$ 在 RoboMME 上达到 58.54% 的成功率，在 LIBERO-Mem 上达到 80.5% 的成功率，在无需外部推理模型或记忆专用标注的基线方法中表现最佳。消融实验证实了转移内容超越单纯时间线索的贡献，以及延迟记忆准入机制的高效性。将 RoboMME 演示数据扩充十倍可将成功率从 57.67% 提升至 87.50%，同时一个杯子交换诊断实验凸显了过程监督在时间组合中的重要作用。
tldr: LTM 通过将历史交互存储为相邻观测间的紧凑潜在转移，为视觉-语言-动作模型提供轻量级上下文记忆机制，无需语义标注或外部推理模型调用即可在机器人记忆任务上取得同类最佳性能。
en_tdlr: LTM equips vision-language-action models with lightweight in-context memory by storing history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations, achieving the best performance among methods that require neither external reasoning models nor memory-specific annotations.
